description: This file contains low-level arithmetic functions for big number (BN) operations, including multiplication, addition, squaring, and division of large integers, used in cryptographic algorithms.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Multiplies a word by a multi-word number and adds the result to a result pointer, handling carry.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Multiplies a multi-word number by a word and stores the result, returning the carry.

methods.name: bn_sqr_words
methods.description: Squares a multi-word number and stores the result.

methods.name: bn_div_words
methods.description: Divides a 64-bit number (h,l) by a word d, returning the quotient.

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Adds two multi-word numbers and stores the result, returning the carry.
